note:
⛔ SNG-499. THE MECHANICAL EFFECT VOCABULARY. Erik: 'I think we need a GAME MECHANIC LIST we can evaluate all of these skills against — a full mapping of every skill and rank based on WHAT IT DOES at each level. Then when we get skills like these we can easily see that they are NOT CLEARLY MAPPING to what they do.'
⚠️ THIS IS THE INSTRUMENT THE AUDIT HAS BEEN MISSING. `functions` say what a craft is FOR (bind, reveal). `shape` says how it resolves (strike, guard). ⛔ NEITHER SAYS WHAT HAPPENS AT THE TABLE. This does.
⛔ FIRST MEASUREMENT: 480 OF 952 RANKS — 50% — CLAIM NO RECOGNISABLE MECHANIC IN THEIR GRANT TEXT.
_rule: ⛔ EVERY RANK MUST NAME AT LEAST ONE EFFECT FROM THIS LIST, WITH ITS NUMBER. A rank that cannot is either flavour, a duplicate, or unfinished. ⚠️ A rank may name several; a rank naming none does not ship.

DAMAGE.note: ⛔ ONLY damage/strike shapes roll. hobble/hinder dice are never rolled (CCode Q1).

SOAK.note: per-hit reduction for a duration. Corpus band 2-6.

ANTISOAK.note:
⛔ THE TARGET CARRIES IT. A craft with `antisoakImposed: N` leaves the target +N vulnerable; ANY damage from ANY source that gets past their soak is increased by N. ⚠️ IT IS NOT A BONUS THE CASTER CARRIES.
⛔ STACKS WITH PIERCING RATHER THAN COMPETING — piercing ignores soak, antisoak adds to what lands, so a Ki Wield gets both.
⚠️ CCODE 2026-08-16: `antisoakLanded` HAD NO CALL SITE FOR A WEEK. Gated on the arithmetic, never on the wiring. ⛔ A GATE ON THE ARITHMETIC IS NOT A GATE ON THE WIRING — the same shape as every authored-correct-and-invisible finding this month, arriving in the engine layer.

HEAL.states: NdX per round or per use
HEAL.note: ✅ WIRED — verified by probe 2026-08-23. `mechanic.dice` on a healing shape IS read and DOES move a sheet. Ladder L1 1d4, L2 2d4 etc. ⛔ The previous note read 'AUTHORED AND UNREAD — 57 abilities, 27 with dice' and was false.
HEAL._flagWasWrong_20260823: ⛔ THIS FLAG SAID `wired: false` AND THE ENGINE DISAGREED. Corrected by behavioural probe (`npm run effect-audit`, CCode): chord_of_mending 8d6 vs 1d2 -> 32 vs 2. ⚠️ I AUTHORED THE FALSE FLAG AND THEN CONSULTED IT AS EVIDENCE — I told CCode healing dice were unread and gated the Spirit audit on it. A flag nobody can trust is worse than no flag, because it gets consulted.

TEMP_SOAK.states: soak N, empties at contest end

ACTION_LOSS.note: ⚠️ CCODE: `phaseDenied` denies the sense step and sets `senseBlinded` — the shape to build from.
ACTION_LOSS._flagWasWrong_20260823: ⛔ THIS FLAG SAID `wired: false` AND THE ENGINE DISAGREED. Corrected by behavioural probe (`npm run effect-audit`, CCode): ki_wield imposes action_loss -> the opponent's condition block moves. ⚠️ I AUTHORED THE FALSE FLAG AND THEN CONSULTED IT AS EVIDENCE — I told CCode healing dice were unread and gated the Spirit audit on it. A flag nobody can trust is worse than no flag, because it gets consulted.

UNCONSCIOUS.note: ⚠️ CCODE: I WAS HALF WRONG. The engine has its own end-state — 'incapacitation, never engine-imposed death'. Keening does not need a new state, it needs a way to IMPOSE the existing one.

SENSE_SLOT.states: resolves in sense slot, action free
SENSE_SLOT.note: CCODE-45 ships sense→action→bonus; CCODE-51 contests the read.

DENY_READ.note: ⚠️ passive today via senseResistOf; declared choice is new.

REVEAL.states: ⛔ NAME THE SPECIFIC FACT RETURNED — not 'you know about it'
REVEAL.note: ⛔ 130 ranks claim this and most do not say WHAT is returned. The commonest empty mechanic.

CONCEAL.states: unseen against N, or until you act

WARD_AREA.states: named category cannot cross, area A, duration D

BIND_TARGET.states: target cannot take named action for D

VULNERABLE._flagWasWrong_20260823: ⛔ THIS FLAG SAID `wired: false` AND THE ENGINE DISAGREED. Corrected by behavioural probe (`npm run effect-audit`, CCode): grief_strike authors antisoakImposed -> the opponent's condition block moves. ⚠️ I AUTHORED THE FALSE FLAG AND THEN CONSULTED IT AS EVIDENCE — I told CCode healing dice were unread and gated the Spirit audit on it. A flag nobody can trust is worse than no flag, because it gets consulted.

SUMMON.states: N entities, duration D, what they can do

MAKE_OBJECT.states: what is made, how long it takes, how long it lasts

SOCIAL_ACCESS.states: ⛔ WHAT DOOR OPENS AND WHOSE COOPERATION — Palework is the model

PERSIST_UNTIL_HEALED.states: effect lasts until a mending craft lifts it
PERSIST_UNTIL_HEALED.note: ⛔ CCODE: durations are ROUNDS (craftDurationMax default 5). 'Until healed' is NOT A LONGER DURATION, IT IS A DIFFERENT CLOCK — needs a condition the rest-and-recovery path clears.

PROJECT_TICKS.states: banks progress per world tick to a threshold

_measurement._note: ⛔ REVEAL IS THE COMMONEST CLAIM AND THE EMPTIEST — 130 ranks, most of which say 'you know' without naming what is returned. ⚠️ THAT IS THE SAME FINDING AS THE 519 PERCEIVE ROWS, arriving from a different direction.

_howToUse: ⛔ FOR EACH RANK: name the effect, give its number, and check the effect is WIRED. If it is not wired, the number is intent and must be flagged for CCode. ⚠️ IF NO EFFECT FITS, THE RANK IS NOT A MECHANIC — it is flavour, a duplicate, or unfinished, and the six questions (§32.11) will say which.
_threeClasses:
⛔ ERIK 2026-08-16: 'The items that say REVEAL, or a few other areas, MIGHT be RELYING ON THE GM TO AUTHOR THE OUTCOME — and that IS A REAL EFFECT. So let's list out what we're relying on the model for.'
⚠️ HE IS RIGHT AND MY FIRST LIST WAS WRONG BY OMISSION. I counted 480 ranks as 'claiming no mechanic' when many of them claim a MODEL-ADJUDICATED one. ⛔ IN AN LLM-RUN GAME, 'THE MODEL DECIDES WHAT YOU FIND' IS A MECHANIC — it is simply resolved by a different engine.
⛔ THREE CLASSES:
   ENGINE — a number the code computes. Damage, soak, antisoak, duration, tempo.
   MODEL — an outcome the model authors. ⚠️ THE RANK MUST STATE WHAT THE MODEL IS OBLIGED TO PRODUCE, or it is not a mechanic, it is a mood.
   PERMISSION — a binary capability that changes what may be attempted at all. Walk on air; be unseen while acting; address the dead. ⚠️ The model adjudicates the attempt; the PERMISSION is not negotiable.

modelAdjudicated._principle: ⛔ A MODEL EFFECT IS A CONTRACT WITH THE MODEL, NOT AN ABSENCE OF ONE. 'You know what is failing' is not a mechanic. 'THE MODEL MUST NAME ONE SPECIFIC FAILING THING, ITS CAUSE, AND ROUGHLY HOW LONG IT HAS' is. ⚠️ THE TEST: could two different GMs produce answers that differ in KIND rather than in detail? If yes, the contract is underspecified.

NAME_A_FACT.contract: ⛔ The model must name ONE specific, checkable fact of a stated kind — not a hint, not an atmosphere.
examples: True Account: what is failing, roughly how long it has, and what it will go from
Attended End: what ended, how, and whether it was natural or made
NAME_A_FACT.underspecified: ⚠️ 'The room remembers correctly' · 'you perceive the meaning-layer' · 'you understand the situation'

NAME_A_WEAKNESS.contract: ⛔ The model must name a specific exploitable feature that a player can then act on THIS SCENE.
examples: Deduced Strike: the old injury, the badly-set strap, the foot carrying the weight
Keystone Blow: which stone the structure is resting on

NARRATE_ACCESS.contract: ⛔ The model must state WHICH door opens, WHOSE cooperation you get, and what they will not do.
examples: Palework: the body, the room, the records, and the family's own account

ADJUDICATE_PLAUSIBILITY.contract: ⚠️ The model rules whether an attempt is within the craft's stated bound — and the bound must be concrete enough to rule on.
examples: My Reality: the picture must be plausible for the place
Formcraft: was this craft witnessed, described, or neither

AUTHOR_A_CONSEQUENCE.contract: ⛔ The model must author a durable change to the world state and RECORD it.
examples: Shared Grief r3: the grief becomes part of what the place IS — recorded in the world, not the character
Case Closed r3: a community stops relitigating

SPEAK_AS.contract: ⛔ The model must voice a specific entity with stated limits on what it knows and will say.
examples: Ask the Dead: the recently dead answer, and they answer as they were
Attended End: Marrow tells you, and never softens it

permission._principle: ⛔ A PERMISSION CHANGES WHAT MAY BE ATTEMPTED. It is binary, it is not rolled, and the model may not refuse it — only adjudicate the attempt made under it.
examples: Skydancer: you may take a step on nothing
Loose-Limbed r2: you may attempt to leave any physical hold
Ignore Me: you may act in the open unattended
Palework r2: a body you handled cannot be raised
Attended End: you may ask what is ending

_forCCode: ⛔ FILL IN THE `wired` COLUMN AND CORRECT ME. ⚠️ For each ENGINE effect: does a field exist, is it read, and where? For each MODEL effect: is there a prompt path that carries the contract to the model, or is the contract invisible at runtime? ⛔ THE SECOND QUESTION IS THE ONE I CANNOT ANSWER FROM CONTENT — a contract the model never sees is not a contract.
_ccodeCorrections_20260816:
⛔ CCODE REPLY. (1) `rank.grants` REACHES THE MODEL VERBATIM via `progression.abilitiesForGM`, registered `reachedBy: always` on turn/ask/gambit. The six model contracts work exactly as written. ⚠️ SO THE WIRE WAS ALWAYS THERE AND NOBODY WAS WRITING CONTRACTS INTO IT.
⛔ (2) ONLY THE RANK THE PLAYER HOLDS IS SENT — `tree.find(t => t.rank === owned.level)`. EVERY RANK'S `grants` MUST BE SELF-CONTAINED. 'ADDS DURATION AND ABSENCE' tells the model nothing because it never saw r1. ⚠️ THIS INVALIDATES MY ENTIRE 'ADDS X' PHRASING CONVENTION ACROSS BOTH FINISHED TRADITIONS.
⛔ (3) `cannot` IS SENT TOO as `CANNOT (at this rank)` and is the clamp the model reads. A sharp `grants` with a vague `cannot` is half-specified in the direction that causes trouble.
⛔ (4) MAX RANK 3 IS ENFORCED, not convention — `rules.leveling.maxAbilityRank` in resolution.json, checked at two sites in progression.js. My five-rank tree was two rows the engine refuses to reach.

engineTracksButNoCraftNames._note: ⛔ CCODE §4c — real, engine-resolved, and NO ability vocabulary reaches them. This is the biggest authoring opportunity in the file.

MOMENTUM.what: the meter the margin delta drives; pressure ticks read it
MOMENTUM.note: ⚠️ the sense step deliberately does not move it (`senseMovesMomentum !== true`)

PRESSURE_EXIT.what: per-kind: what a tick costs each side and how many break them
PRESSURE_EXIT.note: ⛔ KIND-AGNOSTIC — a debate can break someone, not just a fight

EVASION_RANK.what: `evasionOf` — at rank 1 an attacker who read you first still finds you; at rank 2+ the read stops helping
EVASION_RANK.note: ⛔ AUTHORABLE TODAY AND ALMOST NOTHING AUTHORS IT

SOAK_LAYERS_TYPED.what: `answers(l)` matches a layer to a damage KIND; a wrong-type layer contributes nothing
SOAK_LAYERS_TYPED.note: ⛔ `damageType` / `wardTypes` are LIVE and mostly unauthored on crafts

AFFINITY.what: absorb / immune / doubled — a foe that FEEDS on a kind takes a negative hit

CONTEST_MODS.what: a standing effect modifies the round AFTER the one that created it

DEGRADE_IF_SPENT.what: an empty pool silently reduces a declaration to a bare effort
DEGRADE_IF_SPENT.note: ⚠️ NO CRAFT NAMES WHAT IT DEGRADES TO — worth authoring for a bound ward or a held regard

_lethalityClarification_20260816:
⛔ SNG-514. TWO DIFFERENT THINGS, AND I CONFLATED THEM:
   `harmRung: lethal` + `shape: damage` — ⛔ THE CRAFT KILLS. It does so through the damage path like any other killing blow. The Cut Thread, and anything else Erik authors as lethal.
   `mechanic.imposes` — CONDITIONS SHORT OF DEATH ONLY: action_loss, staggered, unconscious, incapacitated. ⚠️ The engine refuses `slain` HERE because this field exists for the space BELOW killing, not because crafts may not kill.
⛔ A CRAFT THAT KILLS DOES IT WITH DAMAGE AND A LETHAL RUNG. A craft that takes someone out of a fight WITHOUT killing them uses `imposes`. ⚠️ MOST CRAFTS SHOULD BE THE SECOND KIND — that is the design — BUT 'most' IS NOT 'all', AND I TURNED A FIELD CONSTRAINT INTO A WORLD RULE.
_wiredFlagsAreClaims_20260823: ⛔ STANDING NOTE. The `wired` flag on every effect below is an ASSERTION ABOUT THE ENGINE MADE IN A CONTENT FILE, and three of 22 were wrong on 2026-08-23 — all three in the same direction, claiming unbuilt what was built. ⚠️ THE ONLY HONEST WAY TO SET ONE IS A BEHAVIOURAL PROBE: run the engine with the field and without it and see whether the output moves. A grep cannot answer it — `foothills` was live in `engine/` and dead in play with every gate green. ⛔ 16 of 22 are still UNPROBED, which is NOT a verdict: it means no honest test exists yet, and they are neither wired nor inert. Do not read an unprobed effect's flag as evidence of anything.
